about_the_game:
Infinite Fantasy Battlefront is a real-time strategy game with a background setting in a world of science fiction and fantasy. It features various civilizations and factions of different styles, and more will be continuously added during the game's operation and updates. Players can use different heroes and armies to play by themselves or with friends in multiple PVP and PVE modes. The game's overall art style leans towards a two-dimensional Japanese anime style, which will be somewhat different from the real-time strategy games many players have previously encountered.

In the initial release version, we will have language support for Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese. Players can use two factions with completely different styles, and a third faction will be quickly updated in the future. After the three factions are updated, as we have promised, we will continuously add more civilizations, factions, and heroes to the game during the long-term operation and updates that follow.

Players can experience multiple different modes in the game, including standard 1v1 and multi-v-multi PVP, as well as vs. AI modes. There is also a cooperative mission mode for 2 to 4 players to play together, which is completely different from the standard game and has an independent progression system.

Our in-game battlefields are diverse and varied, from bustling cities to natural forests, beautiful islands and the depths of the ocean, and even the vast sea of stars. Because of the special world view, our game can have infinite possibilities. Therefore, unit combat within the game can simultaneously take place in three combat zones: land, sea, and air, with land forces, amphibious units, navy, and air force. At the same time, during a match, players can control a legendary hero unit to fight alongside you. In the game, you can also see various special locations on the map, such as shops, and encounter creeps. Creeps, as neutral enemies, are an indispensable part of this game. Our game also has a wide variety of attack types, defense types, and special skills, which are part of the game's balance and fun. The game also has a unique faction color distinction system. With increasingly high-definition and detailed model textures and graphics, it becomes difficult for players to identify more details. In response to this unavoidable problem, we have tried to innovate in this new era, attempting to help players better distinguish between friendly and enemy units.

The overall gameplay is relatively similar to traditional real-time strategy games. In the standard mode, your goal is to defeat your opponent and destroy all enemy buildings. You can also build, produce, and engage in army combat in the standard mode. This game's resource acquisition is not very dependent on workers; most resource acquisition is automatically obtained from constructed buildings. Players need to contest resource points on the map, and the total amount of resources that can be obtained from these points is infinite.

In the special co-op mode, players work together to complete corresponding co-op objectives and bonus objectives, and after the game ends, they will settle and gain experience to raise the corresponding co-op level of the faction they played, in order to unlock new things and bonuses. This is a completely PVE cooperative progression mode, and we highly recommend it for casual and new RTS players to try.

Regarding the two launch factions, the first is the Earth Defense Force from the humans of Earth. They are humanity's most powerful military at present. Initially formed by a United Nations resolution, it is a protector army for all of human civilization, jointly formed by the armies of various human nations. Later, with the peaceful unification of human civilization, the various nations of humanity became distinct regions, and humanity eventually unified into a single nation named the Human Civilization. The Earth Defense Force has since become its most official and powerful army, fighting to protect all of human civilization.
They possess a wide variety of mechanical vehicles, from tanks to fighter jets, from mechs to naval warships. They also have powerful and resolute human soldiers, led by Commander-in-Chief General Connor to protect the future of humanity.

The second comes from the depths of the ocean. They have always existed, but almost no one has truly discovered them. Their technology and magic are extremely advanced, capable of even obtaining endless energy from other worlds in the multiverse. They are the masters of the ocean, Atlantis. The force that players can use is very special. They are not the regular forces of Atlantis, but a special royal guard unit; they are the Royal Guard of the Atlantean Princess. They are led by the god-like powerful member of the Atlantean royal family, Princess Claudia, with troops composed of standard Atlantean soldiers to various murlocs and mermaids. They use various high-tech equipment and have mages who can use magic. They also possess powerful, large bionic-shaped vehicles created with technology and magic. All Atlantean units have amphibious capabilities and receive extra bonuses when in water. In addition to their normal health, they also have shields.

Soon after the initial version is launched, we will also update with the third faction. They are darker, more terrifying, and more distinctive. This will be an evil, Cthulhu-mythos-style Elder God faction, a cult organization led by an evil god, leading cultists, monsters mutated by the evil god's infection, and the evil god's spawn to expand and spread together. Please look forward to it.

The game will be continuously operated and updated, constantly adding new content, from new civilizations, factions, units, and heroes, ranked play rewards, to a wide variety of cosmetics, emotes, skins, and battle passes. We will guarantee that as long as the game is still in operation and players are still playing, we will also continue to update it, working together with players to make the game better and better.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains certain violent and bloody content as well as some nude and pornographic content.
